subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Should OpenClaw add a core provider-family fallback contract here, and if so should the public shape be wildcard/auto refs, fallbackFamilies, catalog-derived fallbacks, or a plugin/ClawHub surface?
rationale: The issue is not a narrow broken-code repair: each proposed shape creates a different public config and provider-routing contract with auth, quota, and upgrade implications.

options.title: Choose one core fallback contract
options.body: Approve one public fallback-family shape and require schema, runtime, docs, and upgrade behavior to be implemented together.

options.title: Route dynamic selection to plugins
options.body: Keep core explicit fallbacks only and direct policy-style routing or provider-family discovery to plugin hooks or ClawHub packages.

options.title: Defer and document current behavior
options.body: Leave explicit flat fallbacks as the supported contract for now and document the manual model-update workaround more clearly.

recommendation.title: Choose one core fallback contract
recommendation.body: Approve one public fallback-family shape and require schema, runtime, docs, and upgrade behavior to be implemented together.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal on the fallback resolver and this decision changes the public model fallback contract.
